en.abdullah-al-shahin: (19) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed bin Oqda narrated from Ja’far bin Abdullah al-Muhammadi from Shareef bin Sabiq at-Tafleesi from al-Fadhl bin Abu Qurra at-Tafleesi from Ja’far bin Muhammad as-Sadiq (as) that his father Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:
'The believers are tested and purified by Allah. Allah has not assured the believers from calamities and distresses of this life but He has assured them from being wretched in the afterlife.'
Then he said: 'Ali bin Al-Husayn bin Ali used to lay his dead side by side and say: 'Our dead are the dead of the prophets.'
